profile.headline: Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | JPA | Hibernate | Spring Cloud | Spring Security |Apache Kafka | Kubernetes | Docker | AWS | JIRA | CICD
profile.summary:
Senior Java Developer with over 12 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance backend systems across telecom, enterprise, and digital service domains. Highly skilled in building robust microservice architectures using Java (up to version 17), Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka, with strong expertise in SQL, JPA, and RESTful API development. Proficient in containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and experienced with AWS cloud services.

Proven track record of leading development teams in Agile environments, resolving complex production issues, and delivering critical, high-impact features focused on scalability, maintainability, and performance optimization. Experienced working on-site in the USA and Australia, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and offshore counterparts. Served as a key liaison between onshore and offshore teams to streamline communication, code integration, and knowledge sharing across global development efforts.
